Jake Paul claims he 'only needs one punch' to knock out Cedric Doumbe ahead of Christmas Eve showdown in Dubai
Jake Paul has asserted that he will "only need one punch" to knock out mixed martial artist Cedric Doumbe; Paul will fight Cedric Doumbe on Christmas Eve in Dubai at the top of a Most Valuable Promotions card
Wednesday 11 November 2026 15:50, UK
Jake Paul has boldly claimed he will "only need one punch" to knock out mixed martial artist Cedric Doumbe when the pair meet in the ring on Christmas Eve in Dubai.
The 29-year-old Paul is set to face French MMA star Doumbe on December 24 in Dubai, with his promotion company, Most Valuable Promotions (MVP), billing the contest as a "professionally sanctioned eight-round cruiserweight bout".
Doumbe, a former two-time Glory welterweight kickboxing champion, boasts an impressive 75-7-1 record in kickboxing, including 45 knockouts. He is also 6-1 in mixed martial arts and 1-0 as a professional boxer, having beaten Mohamed Fodil on points in his sole boxing appearance back in 2015.
"I just need one punch," Paul told a press conference. "I did it 45 times before. One punch. Only one punch.
"You have eight rounds. I only need one punch. And he thinks he will avoid every punch? That's impossible.
"[Cedric's] boxing [is his weakness]. He got only three punches. Jab. Right hook. And body jab. That's it. No power. Nothing.
"He's fat. No abs. Nothing. Only good tattoos. But tattoos don't help you in the ring."
However, Paul dropped out of the WBA cruiserweight rankings following his sixth-round knockout defeat to Anthony Joshua in Miami last December. The loss also cast doubt over his boxing future, with the American requiring surgery to repair his jaw.
Asked about his recovery, Paul insisted he was ready to return, revealing that his jaw had been reinforced with titanium.
"Titanium. Stronger than ever. We're ready for this guy. Kickboxing world champion, Glory champion, one of the best in MMA, this guy is great, he is great. But he's getting knocked out on Christmas Eve," Paul said.
"Kickboxing will not help him, people."
